system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> Can I request that you give us the option to search through all of our saved songs by genre? I have 1,263 songs and it’s a hassle to try to go through each one just to make a playlist dedicated to a specific genre. Thanks!"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hi Mary! Thanks for the feedback. We'll pass it on to the right team. Be sure to vote for a similar idea at <URL>"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Personalize greeting and clarify voting link placeholder."}
